name: Pusaka
description: Read-only MCP server for Pusaka: NFTs on NEAR (testnet) that each control native Bitcoin, plus ETH/USDC, SOL and a NEAR account, through NEAR Chain Signatures. Tools: overview, inspect, loan offers, proof-of-reserves audit, contract trust, history, borrower credit record, loan watch, deals, portfolio, market book. Free, no auth, no keys held; trading tools run only in the local stdio server (npx pusaka-mcp) with the agent's own NEAR key.

pusakaTrustSources.reads: NEAR testnet pusaka-v2.testnet (or the classic pusaka-btc.testnet): code sha256, NEP-330 source, every access key, upgrade DAO and timelock
NEAR MPC key derivation, the contract's proven deposits and Bitcoin itself (proof of reserves per token)
the contract's on-chain loan history per borrower: taken, repaid, defaulted, open
